notes: Button and axis map can be overridden by bluetooth-map.json next to the app.
HIDP control transactions follow net/bluetooth/hidp/hidp.h; no reply is a bare stall.
SDP record is well-formed XML so BlueZ can publish the HID service.
Duplicated button codes in a map are reported and never sent silently.
The adapter is powered back on when the Stock OS service is restored.
